verification_report.summary: The full four-stage proof is correct under the stipulated internal premises, conditional only on the two weighted-limit lemmas in item 7. The sequential audit found no critical errors or gaps. Stage 1 constructs an ordinary-minimal-type lower barrier, establishes ordinary type using the envelope upper bound, and passes to the equation with a fixed finite dominator. Stage 2 supplies a common lower bound of ordinary type phi and validly applies the conditional limit lemma despite the different finite-index singularity types. Stage 3 correctly cancels finite measures on stretched contact sets; disjoint first-contact pieces avoid any factor N, and the first moment uses the fixed reference u. Stage 4 establishes lower supremum bounds before applying carrier CLN; its capped rooftops have both uniform moments relative to u-2delta and one fixed finite NPP dominator. Genuine L1 limits are established before fixed-dominator continuity yields the common lower envelope. Every weighted-limit application retains the original subsequence truncation levels and asserts only the permitted convergence. Exponent scaling, translation, ordinary-type preservation, and uniqueness via finite raw measures are valid even when the undamped weighted measure has infinite mass. No arbitrary-model finite-measure existence theorem or cohomological mass equality is imported. The attribution to [XL26 Proposition 6.1](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.13446v1) was verified without treating its stronger global hypotheses as premises of this reconstruction. Detailed checks are persisted in the run's statement_checks and reference_checks channels.
